question: Spot the **correct spelling** of plant-based pollution cleanup.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Phytoremediation .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Phytoremediation** refers to the use of plants to clean up environmental pollutants.
 
• Among the options provided, **Phytoremediation** is spelled correctly.
 
• The other options contain spelling errors and do not represent the correct term.

Correct spelling: *Phytoremediation*, which is a technique used in environmental cleanup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phytoremediation Techniques:**

 
 
• **Phytoextraction:** Plants absorb contaminants from the soil into their tissues.
 
• **Phytodegradation:** Plants break down pollutants within their structure.
 
• **Rhizofiltration:** Plant roots absorb and filter pollutants from water.
 
 
 
• This method is cost-effective and environmentally friendly compared to traditional cleanup techniques.
